correctness.rationale: For R=iota(k[x,y,z])+D with D=k^(Omega), Omega=X×N, X Zariski dense, repeated infinite fibers, iota(A)∩D=0 because nonzero polynomial values repeat infinitely often; hence R/D≅A. Any prime containing D pulls back uniquely from Spec A. A prime P not containing D omits some coordinate idempotent delta_omega; orthogonality ensures exactly one such omega; delta_omega(1−delta_omega)=0 forces 1−delta_omega∈P and then P=M_omega. M_omega are isolated clopen maximal and minimal; D also minimal and dimR=dimA=3. For e=iota(f)+d idempotent, coordinate fibers plus Zariski density force f(f−1)=0 in the domain A, hence f=0 or 1, and e=chi_F or 1−chi_F with F finite. Confirmed actual proof and full exact source assumptions; this is symbolic, not a purported finite verification.
